title: Add a reusable post-additive Layer 7e P/T-switch effect representation

evidence.fact: A previous proposal passed a simple swap but failed 2/5 +1/+2: it produced 8/5 by snapshotting in Layer 7b; the required result is 7/3 after a post-additive switch.
ContinuousEffect models 7b setters and 7c additive modifiers, but no switch field or Layer 7e default/query exists.
The independent getters currently calculate base/7b, then 7c, then 7d counters, and need one shared post-7d swap decision without recursive getter calls.

required_behavior: Introduce one opt-in ContinuousEffect representation for switching power and toughness, with default Layer 7e semantics; existing effects remain behaviorally unchanged.
For an affected creature, calculate 7b setters, 7c bonuses, and 7d counters before applying the switch. Do not snapshot current P/T into SetPower or SetToughness.
The two public getters must agree on a single pair of post-layer values and must not recursively call each other.
Matching is scoped through the existing effect-affects-card logic. Two simultaneous switch effects cancel; removal or UntilEOT cleanup restores the unswitched values.
This foundation does not add parser output, Map conversion, or a switch_pt ability-dispatch case; those remain in the dependent ticket.
gates: gofmt -d backend/game/effects.go backend/game/card.go backend/game/switch_pt_layer_test.go produces no output
git diff --name-only contains only the allowed paths

execution.selection_reason: This is a compact but semantic Engine foundation with a discriminating runtime invariant. It is deliberately routed to the staged expert profile, not the local capability-decision profile; the Codex adapter remains unavailable on this host because its bwrap setup fails before code inspection.

on_failure: Return an immutable receipt with raw telemetry and either NEEDS_PRIMITIVE, REFACTOR_FIRST, SPLIT_REQUIRED, or one constrained proposal. Do not expand into parser, conversion, or ability dispatch work.
